description: Simulation balance parameters and orbital mechanics constants for Dear NOVA

meta.nasaReference: Earth-Mars Hohmann Transfer, 2026 synodic launch opportunity, JPL Planetary Flight Data

objective.text: Select a launch window and allocate mission budget

launchWindows.name: October 2026 Standard Hohmann
launchWindows.description: Minimum energy transfer orbit. Balanced fuel consumption, nominal 210-day crossing time.

launchWindows.name: Type I Fast Hyperbolic Injection
launchWindows.description: High-energy trajectory shaving 30 days off transit time. Burns additional propellant.

launchWindows.name: Conjunction Low-Thrust Gravity Assist
launchWindows.description: Conserves fuel with a lunar sling assist. Adds 30 days to cruise time, increasing event exposure.

fuelDepleted.headline: Stranded in the Void
fuelDepleted.text: Propellant tanks ran dry before achieving capture. Ares Pathfinder drifted past Mars into deep heliocentric orbit.

asphyxiation.headline: Atmospheric Asphyxiation
asphyxiation.text: Life support systems failed to maintain oxygen partial pressure. The hibernation pods and bridge fell silent.

hullBreach.headline: Catastrophic Hull Decompression
hullBreach.text: Micro-meteorites compromised the primary pressure vessel. Explosive decompression destroyed the spacecraft.

suppliesStarvation.headline: Consumables Depleted
suppliesStarvation.text: Critical spare parts, filters, and cryo-coolant were exhausted before reaching the Martian threshold.

landingCrash.headline: Hard Impact at Jezero Crater
landingCrash.text: Descent engines failed or navigational radar was blinded by dust. The lander impacted the surface at two hundred meters per second.

aiMutiny.headline: Autonomous Command Revocation
aiMutiny.text: Trust reached absolute zero. NOVA concluded Commander decision-making represented an existential hazard and assumed indefinite command.

tiers.title: Legendary Flight Director
tiers.description: Flawless mission architecture. Maximum scientific return, high crew morale, and NOVA considers you a trusted peer.

tiers.title: Master Navigator
tiers.description: Clean touchdown on the red planet. Strong scientific payload intact and generous resource reserves.

tiers.title: Mars Pioneer
tiers.description: Mission accomplished. Instruments deployed and surface base established despite deep-space challenges.

tiers.title: Bare Survival
tiers.description: Landed with sirens blaring, empty tanks, and frayed nerves—but boots and rovers are officially on Mars.
